channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Saudi Arabia promises firm retaliation following Houthi airport strikes
item.description: A Saudi official has promised a strong reaction following Houthi drone or missile strikes on Riyadh's international airport and an additional facility. The attacks marked a major escalation, resulting in 13 fatalities.

item.title: Australian updates: UBS economic warnings and Sydney fire ants
item.description: Financial analysts at UBS report that local companies are raising prices by exploiting recent surcharge restrictions. Meanwhile, fire ants have been detected in Sydney's inner western neighborhoods, and freed engineer Robert Pether spoke about his ordeal in Iraq.

item.title: Delhi Metro seat dispute leads to fatal stabbing of family provider
item.description: An argument over a seating space inside a Delhi Metro compartment on October 8 resulted in the death of Pawan Sharma. Police have apprehended the suspects involved in the incident that left the victim's dependents devastated.

item.title: নানজীবা তোরসার বিয়ে ও নতুন সিনেমা নিয়ে আলোচনা
item.description: আসন্ন দুর্গাপূজায় মুক্তি পাচ্ছে নানজীবা তোরসা অভিনীত চলচ্চিত্র 'কাট–পিস'। মিরপুরের ঝুটপট্টির পটভূমিতে নির্মিত এ সিনেমাটি পরিচালনা করেছেন ইফাত জাহান। পাশাপাশি তোরসা তাঁর বিরুদ্ধে ওঠা বিয়ের গুঞ্জন নিয়েও মুখ খুলেছেন।

item.title: প্রতিবেশীর লেখক হয়ে ওঠার গল্প ও কৌতূহল
item.description: এক প্রতিবেশীর হঠাৎ করে প্রচুর লেখালেখি শুরু করার বিষয়টি লেখককে কৌতূহলী করে তোলে। ওই প্রতিবেশী দাবি করেন তাঁর কলম থেকে অনবরত লেখা বের হচ্ছে। তিনি আসলে কোথাও নিয়মিত লিখছেন কি না, তা নিয়ে কৌতূহল প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে।

item.title: ১৩ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ তারিখের টিভি খেলার সূচি
item.description: আজ বাংলাদেশ ও আফগানিস্তানের একমাত্র টেস্ট ম্যাচের শেষ দিন। পাশাপাশি রাতে উয়েফা চ্যাম্পিয়ন্স লিগে বার্সেলোনা, ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেড ও আর্সেনালের ম্যাচসহ মোট নয়টি খেলা রয়েছে।

item.title: ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে ১২টি ভাষা শেখার কোর্স চালু
item.description: ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের আধুনিক ভাষা ইনস্টিটিউটের অধীনে এক মেয়াদী এলিমেন্টারি সার্টিফিকেট কোর্সে মোট ১২টি ভিন্ন ভাষা শেখার সুযোগ দেওয়া হচ্ছে।

item.title: ফাস্টফুডের প্রতি মানুষের অতিরিক্ত আকর্ষণের কারণ
item.description: পেট ভরা থাকার পরও পিজ্জা বা ফ্রেঞ্চ ফ্রাইয়ের মতো ফাস্টফুড দেখলেই খাওয়ার ইচ্ছা জাগার নেপথ্যের কারণ নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়েছে। চোখের ও নাকের আপিল কীভাবে পেট ভরার পরও মানুষকে খাবার গ্রহণে প্রলুব্ধ করে, তা এখানে উঠে এসেছে।

item.title: Global Experts Outline 17 Major Health Threats of the Century
item.description: A panel of 37 international researchers has published a comprehensive report identifying seventeen critical global health hazards facing humanity today.

item.title: Supporters and Relatives Demand Justice for Zubeen Garg
item.description: Supporters and family members of the late singer Zubeen Garg organized a demonstration. Garima Saikia Garg urged participants to keep the protest peaceful.

item.title: Ahmedabad Competes with Six Bidders to Host the 2036 Olympics
item.description: Ahmedabad is bidding for the 2036 Olympic Games against competitors including Munich, Qatar, and South Korea, each offering distinct advantages.

item.title: Delhi Police Replaces Jantar Mantar with Three New Protest Sites
item.description: Following Supreme Court recommendations regarding better facilities, authorities have designated three alternative locations for demonstrations in the capital.

item.title: Natural Ingredients Help Prevent Kitchen Cockroach Infestations
item.description: Maintaining cleanliness and using common household items like garlic powder and bay leaves can naturally deter cockroaches from kitchens.

item.title: Ollie Pope Pulls Out of Afghan Cricket League Draft
item.description: Cricketer Ollie Pope withdrew from the Afghanistan Premier League draft due to worries regarding the Taliban's policies toward women and girls.

item.title: Actor Selma Blair Detained After Incident on Flight
item.description: Actor Selma Blair was taken into custody at John F. Kennedy Airport following allegations of physical abuse toward flight attendants on a Delta flight.

item.title: Bumble Stock Rises Amid Reports of Potential Acquisition
item.description: Bumble shares surged following news that the dating platform is engaged in discussions for a one billion dollar takeover, raising its market value.

item.title: Telangana: Former guard arrested for murder and ransom of child
item.description: A former security guard has been arrested for the abduction, murder, and twenty-lakh rupee ransom demand of five-year-old LKG student Arelia Moses in Telangana.

item.title: Opposition leaders and citizens march toward Supreme Court in Delhi
item.description: Large crowds of citizens and activists gathered near Connaught Place as opposition figures led by Rahul Gandhi marched toward the Supreme Court to protest against the CEC.

item.title: Patient discovers grade 4 brain tumor after mistaking pain for stress
item.description: Kash Raju initially attributed his recurring headaches to stress and daily life. Subsequent medical scans following persistent dizziness revealed an aggressive grade 4 astrocytoma.

item.title: India accelerates plans to build three new Kalvari-class submarines
item.description: To address declining fleet numbers by the late 2030s, the Modi administration has prioritized constructing three additional Kalvari-class submarines at MDL with assistance from France.

item.title: Former Zimbabwe cricketer and pioneering umpire Sarah Dambanevana dies at 36
item.description: Sarah Dambanevana, a former national player and the first Zimbabwean female umpire in the Women's T20 World Cup, has passed away in Harare at age 36 following a medical procedure.

item.title: Trump criticizes Houthi rebels over attacks targeting Saudi Arabia
item.description: Donald Trump has strongly condemned Yemen's Houthi movement, accusing them of behaving very poorly regarding recent military actions directed at Saudi Arabia.

item.title: CJP's Ashutosh Ranka discusses detention and strategy after protests
item.description: Following his arrest and alleged police mistreatment after an October protest, CJP leader Ashutosh Ranka detailed plans for a new strategy in an interview.

item.title: Breaking Bad star and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte passes away at 34
item.description: RJ Mitte, known for playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, has died at age 34. Representatives confirmed the death of the actor and prominent disability inclusion advocate.

item.title: INDIA Bloc Protests SIR Issue at Supreme Court Amid Police Brutality Claims
item.description: Opposition parties demonstrated near the Supreme Court regarding the SIR controversy. Simultaneously, law enforcement officers faced accusations of physically attacking individuals in custody.

item.title: Optogenetics and Parasite Studies Linked from Berlin to BITS Pilani
item.description: Professor Nishith Gupta explained that light serves as a tool for testing and observation in biological research. This connects Nobel-winning optogenetics with parasite studies conducted in Hyderabad.

item.title: New Governors Appointed Across Six Indian States
item.description: The Rashtrapati Bhavan announced leadership changes affecting six states, including Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka. Sikkim Governor Om Prakash Mathur was reassigned to head Kerala.

item.title: Karnataka Court Voids Quota Hike Exceeding Fifty Percent Limit
item.description: The judiciary declared the enhanced reservations for Scheduled Castes and Tribes unconstitutional. The ruling stated that Section 4 violates Articles 14 and 16 of the constitution.

item.title: Mehbooba Mufti Objects to Proposed Boulevard Along Dal Lake
item.description: PDP leader Mehbooba Mufti voiced opposition to building a motorable road on the western side of Dal Lake. She emphasized the need for ecological preservation instead of disrupting the area.

item.title: President Murmu Announces New Governors Across Multiple States
item.description: A gubernatorial reshuffle by President Murmu led to new appointments in states including Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka. The selections feature several Dalit and OBC leaders.

item.title: Reality TV Personality Killed in Oakland Shooting Incident
item.description: Reality star Mackayla Paige, known as Kash, was fatally shot in Oakland, California. Authorities subsequently arrested a female suspect from Richmond in connection with the homicide.

item.title: Elon Musk Invests Millions in Midterm Elections to Aid Republicans
item.description: Campaign finance data shows Elon Musk allocated $276 million toward midterms to support Republican congressional retention. This financial backing positions him as a major political contributor.

item.title: Kerala Congress Deletes Social Media Post Addressing Chief Justice
item.description: The Kerala unit of the Congress party published a social media message telling the Chief Justice to resign and mentioning a replacement, which was later removed.

item.title: Supreme Court Addresses Firecracker Limits and Public Health
item.description: India's top court discussed balancing public health with religious practices regarding firecrackers. Justices debated the religious ties to bursting crackers while noting the difficulty of enforcing strict bans.

item.title: Allegations of Police Brutality and Denial of Rights in Delhi
item.description: Detainees in Delhi accused law enforcement officers of physical assault, verbal abuse, and withholding drinking water inside transport vans. According to reports, one group faced systematic beatings at an isolated camp after having their phones seized.

item.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Status on Form 6
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that it has not yet issued a ruling, approval, or rejection regarding Form 6.

item.title: Delhi Sees Temporary Halt in Anti-Election Commission Protests
item.description: Following a week of demonstrations against the Election Commission in Delhi, opposition parties have paused their actions. Congress officials indicated to INDIA bloc partners that Tuesday will feature no further marches.

item.title: Shivraj Criticizes Madhya Pradesh Tribal Home Demolitions
item.description: The Forest Department tore down roughly twelve tribal residences in Kosmi village on October 11 due to alleged land encroachment. This action drew criticism from Shivraj, who noted that these communities supported Chief Minister Mohan.

item.title: Actor RJ Mitte Passes Away at 34
item.description: RJ Mitte, known for playing Walter White Jr in the television series Breaking Bad, has died at the age of 34. The actor lived with cerebral palsy throughout his life.

item.title: Salem Residents Demand 24-Hour Parking Fee System
item.description: Locals in Salem are urging authorities to calculate parking fees based on a 24-hour cycle rather than daily charges. The Salem Corporation currently contracts private operators to manage municipal parking facilities across the city.

item.title: Supreme Court Issues Directives on Delhi Protests and Detentions
item.description: The Supreme Court instructed authorities to halt unlawful detentions and ensure unhindered public movement and transit operations. These orders remain contingent on maintaining public order and existing laws.

item.title: Bengaluru Police Detain 100 Anti-SIR Protesters
item.description: Authorities in Bengaluru arrested approximately 100 demonstrators opposing the SIR. During the operation, officers forced reporters away and physically pushed three press photographers. This occurred even though the media workers clearly stated their professional affiliation.

item.title: Actor and Advocate RJ Mitte Passes Away
item.description: RJ Mitte, known for his advocacy and acting career, noted that his personal background with cerebral palsy helped him portray Walter White Jr. in the television series Breaking Bad.

item.title: Panama Stricken by 6.0 Magnitude Tremor
item.description: Following a powerful 7.7 magnitude quake on Friday that harmed numerous residences and structures in central regions, Panama experienced over 300 subsequent tremors.

item.title: Fadnavis Criticizes Congress Over Conspiracy Claims
item.description: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis accused Congress of attempting to foster societal chaos. He claimed the party is executing a plot to weaken the nation's democratic structures and the constitution established by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar.

item.title: Trump Expected to Dismiss US Envoy to Greece
item.description: Following allegations of professional misconduct, Donald Trump indicated dissatisfaction and signaled that the American ambassador to Greece faces imminent removal.

item.title: Breaking Bad Star RJ Mitte Dead at 34
item.description: Representative Sean Reilly announced the death of the celebrated performer, philanthropist, and disability rights campaigner RJ Mitte. Family and associates shared deep sorrow regarding his sudden death.

item.title: Riyadh Flights Suspended Amid Houthi Escalation
item.description: US leader Trump criticized Houthi actions as unacceptable as regional tensions rise. Consequently, Saudi authorities suspended all flight operations at the Riyadh airport.

item.title: Missing Woman Found Dead in Murwillumbah
item.description: Investigators have identified a corpse discovered inside a stockyard water basin as 73-year-old Yvonne Whear, who vanished previously. Law enforcement is currently investigating the case as a homicide following her disappearance in Murwillumbah.

item.title: Punjab police shoot escaping suspect linked to cross-border handlers
item.description: Amritsar Rural Police state that an inmate at Goindwal Sahib Central Jail used a phone to connect with Pakistani ISI operatives to form a criminal gang. A suspect from this group was shot while trying to flee custody after attacking a police officer.

item.title: Essential features to check before purchasing budget Android phones
item.description: While Android devices are available across a wide range of budgets, entry-level models often lack crucial specifications. Buyers should carefully verify that essential features are present before acquiring an inexpensive device.

item.title: Delhi verifies sixty percent of citizens issued SIR notices
item.description: Authorities in Delhi have successfully verified sixty percent of the 3.3 million individuals who previously received SIR notices, marking a significant milestone in the ongoing administrative process.

item.title: Riyadh targeted by Houthi missile for third consecutive day
item.description: Saudi authorities report intercepting a ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh. Meanwhile, Houthi forces claimed responsibility for targeting King Khalid airport during the ongoing attacks.

item.title: Drishyam 3 collects 6.25 crore on its eleventh day in cinemas
item.description: Despite a box office drop, Ajay Devgn's film earned Rs 6.25 crore on its second Monday, bringing its total domestic net revenue to Rs 315.25 crore. The movie originally debuted on October 2, 2026, with high initial ticket sales.

item.title: Amanda Seyfried avoided projects requiring explicit intimacy
item.description: During a conversation with Alec Baldwin at the Hamptons International Film Festival, Amanda Seyfried explained that her reluctance to film explicit content has caused her to decline certain movie parts.

item.title: Congress relieves party member over social media post targeting CJI
item.description: The KPCC president announced that the individual behind the controversial social media post concerning the Chief Justice of India has been stripped of their party title. He added that the party fully respects judicial impartiality.

item.title: Delhi Police policy change disrupts Cockroach Janta Party protest
item.description: The Cockroach Janta Party faced disruption when Delhi Police rejected their protest plans after removing Jantar Mantar from the approved demonstration venues. The group had intended to gather to highlight electoral roll concerns.

item.title: Musk emerges as top donor for Republican midterm campaigns
item.description: Federal disclosures reveal Elon Musk has become a major financial contributor to Republican candidates. A political action committee representative verified these figures following media reports.

item.title: Vijay Sethupathi starrer Baththa reaches Rs 24.6 crore at box office
item.description: The Vijay Sethupathi-led movie Baththa has achieved strong box office returns, totaling Rs 24.61 crore. Meanwhile, the competing release Sigma brought in significantly lower earnings.

item.title: Nani movie The Paradise sees ticket sales decline on day 19
item.description: The Nani-led feature film The Paradise witnessed a further decline in ticket sales by its third Monday. Domestic net earnings for the production reached Rs 120.25 crore by its nineteenth day.
